facts.fact: Digital Realty Nigeria's CEO Ike Nnamani, speaking at TSSF 7.0 (Lagos, 16 September 2026), said no single hyperscaler, among them Amazon, Oracle, Meta and Microsoft, operates a data region in Nigeria.

note: Other statements are policy, projections (50 to 200 MW) or the owner's cloud spend; no facility named as in service.
